name: Gradient Computation via Finite Differences
aliases: Gradient Computation via Finite Differences — Central Difference Gradient
Voxel Normal Estimation via Central Differences
definition: Computes the 3D gradient vector for each voxel in a scalar volume using finite differences, storing results in a separate float array.
summary: Gradient Computation via Finite Differences estimates spatial gradients using a minimal 6-neighbor stencil, offering speed over the Sobel operator but lacking its noise robustness.
